title: Governed Action Proposal
description: Canonical domain schema for a governance-significant proposed transition submitted to AGCP runtime-governance evaluation. The object declares stable Proposal Identity, operational intent, target, requested effect, canonical Action Representation, associated Governance Context, provenance, temporal validity, and applicable composite-governance semantics through the canonical DS-035 Bind Set and DS-036 Governance Dependency Graph. A Governed Action Proposal is not execution and does not confer authority at commitment.
$comment: DS-021 is the authoritative Governed Action Proposal domain object. DS-022 is the authoritative Governance Context Envelope and DS-035 is the authoritative Bind Set and DS-036 is the authoritative Governance Dependency Graph. Cross-object equality requirements—such as Tenant, governance-domain, Proposal Identity, target, parent/sub-transition binding, graph-node membership, and dependency endpoint resolution—are semantic Proposal Qualification obligations because standard JSON Schema cannot compare arbitrary values across object locations.
x-agcp-schema-role: Canonical Governance Object — Governed Action Proposal

namespaced_extensions.description: Implementation- or domain-specific extension members. Extension members SHALL be namespace-qualified and SHALL NOT alter, replace, or weaken canonical AGCP proposal semantics.

operational_intent.description: Declared operational intent of the proposed transition. Intent is descriptive governance input and is not authority to execute.

intent_type.description: Stable type or classification of the operational intent.

statement.description: Human-readable statement of the intended operation.

parameters_digest.description: Digest of governance-significant intent parameters when parameters are carried in the Action Representation or an extension payload.

requested_effect.description: Declared operational effect the proposal requests. The requested effect is evaluated rather than presumed admissible.

effect_representation.description: Canonical domain-specific representation of the requested effect. Null is prohibited because an absent effect is not a declared effect.

effect_digest.description: Digest of the canonical requested-effect representation.

action_representation.description: Canonical Governed Action Proposal Representation content used during Proposal Qualification. The representation SHALL contain all governance-significant action information and remain immutable after successful qualification unless governed re-qualification occurs.

schema_ref.description: URI identifying the domain schema used to validate the action payload, when applicable.

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization method used before calculating payload_digest.

payload.description: Canonical domain-specific action payload. Null is prohibited.

sub_transition.description: Governed sub-transition within a composite proposal. Each sub-transition preserves its own identity, target, requested effect, representation, domain, and validity information while remaining linked to the parent proposal.

composite_proposal.description: Composite-proposal structure preserving governed sub-transition identities, dependencies, coupling semantics, authority domains, targets, and aggregate proposal relationships.

dependency_graph.description: Canonical DS-036 Governance Dependency Graph for the governed sub-transitions in this composite proposal. Parent Proposal Identity, Tenant, governance domain, node set, and sub-transition identities SHALL remain consistent with this proposal.

governed_action_proposal_ref.description: Stable integrity-bound reference to the canonical DS-021 Governed Action Proposal.

tenant_id.description: Originating Tenant. This value SHALL match the Tenant encoded in Proposal Identity and the associated Governance Context Envelope.

governance_domain_id.description: Originating governance domain. This value SHALL match corresponding values in Proposal Identity and the associated Governance Context Envelope where present.

action_id.description: Optional stable identifier for the governance-significant Action represented by this proposal.

proposal_kind.description: Classifies whether the proposal represents one governed transition or multiple governed sub-transitions.

validity_window.description: Applicable proposal not-before and/or expiration conditions. If no window is supplied, the applicable implementation profile and governance policy determine temporal validity.

policy_refs.description: Optional policy references supplied as governance input. They do not prevent the governance system from resolving other applicable policy.

governance_context.description: The canonical Governance Context Envelope defined by DS-022. Its Proposal Identity, Tenant, governance domain, target, and other applicable bindings SHALL remain consistent with this proposal.
